blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper introduces GRIP , a pose-conditioned refinement framework for pixel-to-point matching and 2D to 3D registration. Given an initial coarse pose estimate, GRIP addresses the structural mismatch between grid based image descriptors and unordered point cloud descriptors by softly rendering learned 3D point features onto the image grid through Gaussian feature splatting. The rendered point derived feature map is then fused with image features by a pixel aligned transformer, enabling visual semantic and geometric cues to interact in a shared 2D representation. The refined features are decoded and propagated to finer resolutions for dense correspondence estimation and final pose refinement. Experiments on RGB D Scenes V2 and 7 Scenes demonstrate state of the art inlier ratio and competitive registration recall, with stronger performance under stricter evaluation thresholds.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍GRIP ,是像素对点匹配和2D对3D注册的配置条件完善框架. 鉴于最初粗糙的姿势估计,GRIP通过软渲染学到的3D点特征通过高斯特征电镀在图像网格上,解决了基于网格的图像描述符和无序点云描述符之间的结构不匹配. 渲染点衍生的特征映射然后由像素对齐的变压器与图像特征结合,使视觉语义和几何提示能够在共享的2D表示中相互作用. 精细的特征被解码并传播到更精细的分辨率,以便进行密集的函证估计和最后的改进。 对RGB D Scenes V2 和 7 Scenes 的实验显示了最先进的加码比和竞争性登记召回,在更严格的评价阈值下表现更强.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image-to-point cloud registration is a fundamental task in computer graphics, computer vision, and robotics, with applications including robotic navigation [ 38 ] , 3D reconstruction [ 4 ] , and augmented reality [ 25 , 22 ] . It aims to estimate the rigid transformation that registers a 3D point cloud with a partially overlapping 2D camera image.
blocks.zh: 图像对点云注册是计算机图形学,计算机视觉,机器人的一项基本任务,其应用包括机器人导航[38],3D重建[4],以及增强现实[25,22]. 它旨在估计一个3D点云与部分重叠的2D相机图像的刚性转换.

blocks.en: This problem is highly challenging due to the data’s heterogeneous nature. Captured through different modalities, images primarily provide visual cues such as color, texture, and semantics, whereas point clouds provide geometric cues such as spatial structure and local properties. Traditional 2D-3D registration methods typically follow a detect-then-match pipeline composed of three main steps: repeatable keypoints detection, pixel-to-point correspondence estimation, and transformation estimation. In these methods, keypoint detection and correspondence search rely on visual saliency and local geometric structures, while robust estimators, most notably PnP-RANSAC [ 18 , 10 ] , are used to recover the final rigid pose. For a long time, such methods dominated cross-modal registration. However, challenging conditions such as sparse data, limited overlap, and large viewpoint changes make repeatable keypoint detection across these two different domains difficult, thereby degrading performance. To overcome these limitations, 2D3D-MATR [ 19 ] introduced a detection-free pipeline. Inspired by state-of-the-art methods in image matching [ 35 ] and 3D point cloud registration [ 43 , 30 ] , 2D3D-MATR divides the matching process into two complementary levels: coarse-level image patch and point-node matching and dense pixel-to-point matching. This paradigm inspired recent learning methods [ 19 , 41 , 27 , 6 ] which adopted the same coarse-to-fine matching strategy coupled with PnP-RANSAC for scene registration [ 11 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于数据的多样性,这个问题非常具有挑战性。 通过不同方式捕获,图像主要提供视觉提示,如颜色、纹理和语义,而点云提供几何提示,如空间结构和局部属性。 传统的2D-3D注册方法一般遵循一个检测-当时的匹配管道,由三个主要步骤组成:可重复的键点检测,像素对点对应估计,以及变换估计. 在这些方法中,关键点检测和函证搜索依赖于视觉显著性和局部几何结构,而强健的估测器,最著名的是PnP-RANSAC [18,10],用于恢复最终的刚性姿势. 长期以来,这种方法主导了跨模式登记。 然而,由于数据稀少、重叠有限、观点变化大等具有挑战性的条件,很难在这两个不同领域反复发现关键点,从而降低性能。 为了克服这些限制,2D3D-MATR[19]引入了无检测管道. 受图像匹配[35]和3D点云注册[43,30]中最先进的方法启发,2D3D-MATR将匹配过程分为两个互补层面:粗度级图像补丁和点点点匹配和密集像素对点匹配. 这一范式启发了最近的学习方法[19、41、27、6],这些方法采用了同样的粗细比对策略,并结合了PnP-RANSAC进行现场登记[11、17]。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, detection-free 2D-3D matching still relies largely on direct feature comparison between two heterogeneous representations. In these methods, image descriptors are typically extracted using Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) [ 21 ] and ResNet [ 12 ] backbones, and therefore lie on a regular 2D grid that primarily encodes visual appearance and semantic context. In contrast, point cloud descriptors are predicted using backbones such as KPFCNN [ 36 ] , which encode geometric attributes in an unorganized 3D domain. Although existing methods [ 19 , 41 , 27 ] adopt transformers to model cross-modal interactions at the coarsest level, the two modalities remain structurally misaligned during matching: image descriptors are arranged on a dense 2D grid, whereas point cloud descriptors are indexed over an unordered 3D points. As a result, these methods enhance contextual communication but do not explicitly unify the representation space in which cross-modal matching is performed. Moreover, since transformers are introduced only at the coarse level [ 19 , 41 ] and outside the backbone, fine-level features from the two modalities fail to capture cross-modal cues. This modality gap makes dense correspondence estimation challenging, especially under partial overlap, occlusions, and imperfect coarse alignment. Furthermore, once an initial pose is available, it provides a valuable geometric cue that can directly relate 3D points to image locations. However, existing coarse-to-fine pipelines do not fully exploit this pose to construct an image-aligned point cloud representation before refining the matching process.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但无检测的2D-3D匹配仍然在很大程度上依赖于两个不同表示之间的直接特征比较. 在这些方法中,图像描述符通常使用FPN的Feature Pyramid Network(FPN)[21]和ResNet[12]骨干进行提取,因此位于一个主要编码视觉外观和语义上下文的普通2D网格上. 相比之下,点云描述符是使用KPFCNN[36]等骨干来预测的,这些骨干将几何属性编码在一个无组织的3D域中. 虽然现有方法[19,41,27]采用变压器在低温水平上模拟跨模式相互作用,但两种模式在匹配时仍然结构错配:图像描述符排列在密集的2D网格上,而点云描述符则在无序的3D点上进行索引. 因此,这些方法加强了背景交流,但没有明确统一进行跨模式匹配的表示空间。 此外,由于变压器仅在粗体级[19,41]和主干线以外采用,两种方式的细层特性无法捕捉到跨模式的提示. 这种模式差距使得密集的函证估计具有挑战性,特别是在部分重叠、隔离和不完善的粗配的情况下。 此外,一旦有了最初的姿势,它就提供了一个有价值的几何提示,可以直接将立体点与图像位置联系起来。 然而,现有的粗到细的输油管并没有充分利用这种姿势,在完善配对过程之前,构建一个图像对接点云代表.

blocks.en: In this paper, we present GRIP , a pose conditioned refinement framework for image to point cloud registration based on feature splatting [ 15 , 39 ] . Starting from an initial coarse pose estimate, GRIP renders learned 3D point features into the image plane, producing an image aligned representation of the point cloud. This representation serves as a cross modal bridge, enabling pixel aligned interaction between visual features and 3D derived geometric features prior to final correspondence estimation. GRIP therefore changes the interaction space before final matching: instead of refining descriptors only in their original heterogeneous domains, it first renders learned 3D features onto the image plane and then performs cross modal interaction within a shared pixel aligned representation. This representation is subsequently used to refine dense correspondences and recover the final pose, as detailed in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了GRIP, 即基于地物镀层的图像定位云登记的一个有条件改进框架。 从最初粗糙的姿势估计开始,GRIP将学到的3D点特征放入图像平面,产生图像对齐的点云表示. 这种表示式充当了跨模式的桥梁,使得视觉特征和3D派生几何特征在最后的函证估计前能够进行像素对齐的相互作用. 因此,GRIP在最终匹配前会改变交互空间:它不只精炼其原始的异域的描述符,而是首先将学到的3D特性放到图像平面上,然后在一个共享像素对齐的表示中进行跨模式交互. 如第3节所详述,这种表述随后被用来完善密集的函证,并恢复最后的姿势。

blocks.en: In a nutshell, the main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We introduce a Point-to-Pixel feature rendering module that converts unordered point-cloud descriptors into an image-aligned feature map. • We propose a Pixel-Aligned Interaction Transformer that benefits from this intermediate representation and bidirectionally fuses geometric and visual-semantic cues on a shared 2D grid. • We design a hierarchical propagation strategy that injects the fused cross-modal representation into both image and point-cloud decoders, improving coarse and dense 2D-3D matching and pose refinement. • We achieve state-of-the-art matching inlier ratio and competitive registration recall, with stronger performance under stricter thresholds.
blocks.zh: 简言之,本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们引入一个点对像素特性渲染模块,将无序的点-云描述符转换成图像对齐特性映射. ^ 我们提出一个像素相通的相互作用变换器,从这种中间代表中受益,并在共享的2D网格上双向引信几何和视觉语义提示。 我们设计了一个分级传播战略,将熔化的跨模式表示法注入图像和点云解码器,改进粗糙和密集的2D-3D匹配,并作出改进。 我们实现了最先进的匹配率和有竞争力的登记召回,在更严格的阈值下提高业绩。

blocks.en: We introduce a Point-to-Pixel feature rendering module that converts unordered point-cloud descriptors into an image-aligned feature map.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent 2D-3D registration methods draw inspiration from both image matching and 3D point cloud registration. Image matching evolved from handcrafted descriptors [ 32 , 24 ] to learning-based methods [ 7 , 8 ] , with transformer-based architectures such as SuperGlue [ 33 ] improving correspondence estimation through global context aggregation. Similarly, point cloud registration progressed from ICP and its derivatives [ 2 , 42 , 44 ] to deep learning approaches such as DCP [ 40 ] , before recent coarse-to-fine transformer frameworks became the dominant paradigm [ 35 , 43 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 近期的2D-3D注册方法从图像匹配和3D点云注册中汲取灵感. 图像匹配从手工描述器[32,24]演变为基于学习的方法[7,8],其中基于变压器的架构如SuperGlue[33]通过全局环境聚合改进函证估计. 同样,点云登记从比较方案及其衍生工具[2、42、44]发展到深入学习方法,如DCP[40],直到最近的粗细变压器框架成为主导范式[35、43、30]。

blocks.en: Building upon these advances, 2D-3D registration has evolved from detect-and-match pipelines based on handcrafted features [ 20 ] to recent detection-free learning frameworks [ 19 , 41 ] . Inspired by learning-free predecessors [ 34 ] , which extract local features using SIFT [ 24 ] , 2D3DMatchNet [ 9 ] introduces a learning-based approach relying on PointNet [ 29 ] and CNNs to jointly predict descriptors for 2D and 3D keypoints. Moving beyond handcrafted detectors, P2-Net [ 37 ] proposes a dual-fully-convolutional framework that maps 2D and 3D inputs into a shared latent space to jointly detect and describe keypoints. However, as highlighted by 2D3D-MATR [ 19 ] , existing inter-modality methods either rely on scene-specific coordinate regression, thereby limiting generalization to novel scenes, or follow detect-then-match pipelines that are hindered by unstable cross-modal keypoint repeatability and low inlier ratios.
blocks.zh: 在这些进展的基础上,2D-3D的登记从基于手动特性的探测和匹配管道[20]演变为最近的无探测学习框架[19,41]。 在无学习前身[34]的启发下,它利用SIFT[24],2D3DMatchNet[9]引入基于学习的方法,依靠PointNet[29]和CNN共同预测2D和3D键点的描述符. 超越手动探测器,P2Net[37]提出一个双向完全演化的框架,将2D和3D输入映射到共享的潜在空间中,共同探测和描述关键点. 然而,正如2D3D-MATR[19]所强调的,现有的跨模式方法要么依赖于场景特定的坐标回归,从而将泛化到新的场景,要么遵循被不稳定的跨模式键点重复性和低内置比阻碍的检测-当时匹配的管道.

blocks.en: 2D3D-MATR [ 19 ] introduced a detection-free coarse-to-fine framework for 2D-3D registration. Multi-resolution image and point cloud features interact through a transformer [ 1 ] at the coarsest level to establish correspondences that subsequently guide dense pixel-to-point matching. The good performance of 2D3D-MATR on challenging indoor benchmarks such as RGB-D Scenes V2 [ 17 ] and 7-Scenes [ 11 ] inspired several subsequent methods to adopt a similar coarse-to-fine design. In particular, Diff-Reg [ 41 ] extends 2D3D-MATR with a diffusion-based matching framework that preserves the original pipeline and employs a transformer-based denoising module to iteratively refine the coarse matching matrix. Diff 2 I2P [ 27 ] further leverages a depth-conditioned diffusion model to distill cross-modal knowledge and bridge the gap between 2D and 3D features while maintaining the same coarse-to-fine paradigm. More recently, R 23 Net [ 6 ] addressed the issue of non-overlapping and low-quality matching regions inherent to coarse-to-fine 2D-3D registration by first identifying informative regions in both the image and the point cloud through a reinforcement-learning-based High-Value Zone Reinforced Selection module.
blocks.zh: 2D3D-MATR [19]引入了2D-3D注册的无检测粗对细框架. 多分辨率图像和点云特性通过一个变压器[1]在最短的电位上相互作用,以建立函射,从而引导密集的像素对点匹配. 2D3D-MATR在挑战室内基准如RGB-D Scenes V2[17]和7-Scenes[11]上的出色表现激励了之后的几种方法,以采用类似的粗对细设计. 特别是,Diff-Reg [41] 扩展了2D3D-MATR,以扩散为主的匹配框架,保留了原有的管道,并使用一个基于变压器的去诺化模块来迭代精细的匹配矩阵. Diff 2 I2P [27] 进一步利用深度有条件的传播模型来提炼跨模式知识,弥合2D和3D特征之间的差距,同时保持相同的粗对细范式. 最近,R 23 Net [6]首先通过一个基于强化学习的高价值区强化选择模块,确定图像和点云中的信息区,从而解决了粗粗2D-3D登记所固有的不重叠和低质量匹配区域的问题。

blocks.en: In contrast to these approaches, which mainly refine matching scores or cross-modal descriptors within the original feature domains, GRIP explicitly modifies the representation space by rendering 3D descriptors onto the image plane prior to cross-modal interaction.
blocks.zh: 与这些主要在原功能域内精炼匹配分数或跨模式描述符的方法不同,GRIP在跨模式交互前将3D描述符放到图像平面上,从而明确修改了表示空间.

blocks.en: Given an image 𝐈 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} and a point cloud 𝐏 ∈ ℝ N × 3 \mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 3} , the first stage estimates an initial transformation between the two modalities. It follows the coarse-to-fine matching paradigm of 2D3D-MATR [ 19 ] and provides the initialization for the proposed rendering-based refinement module. Multi-resolution features are extracted using modality-specific backbones: KPFCNN [ 36 ] for the point cloud, and a ResNet-FPN backbone [ 12 , 21 ] for the image, with the deepest image features augmented by DINOv2 descriptors [ 28 ] .

blocks.en: 3.3 Feature Rendering-based Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.3 基于特性的改进

blocks.en:
A key design principle of the proposed GRIP is that reliable 2D-3D correspondences should be refined via an intermediate representation that spatially aligns image and point cloud features, rather than only through direct cross-modal descriptor comparison.
Accordingly, GRIP consists of four main components: i) the Point-to-pixel Feature Renderer converts unordered point-cloud descriptors into an image-aligned feature map via pose-aware feature splatting using the initial pose 𝐓 0 \mathbf{T}_{0} . ii) The Pixel-Aligned Interaction Transformer refines image features and rendered 3D-derived features through bidirectional cross-modal attention on a shared 2D grid. iii) The Hierarchical Cross-Modal Feature Propagation maps the refined rendered features back to the sparse 3D nodes, yielding updated point cloud descriptors enriched with visual information. iv) Matching and Pose Estimation uses the refined descriptors to recover improved dense 2D-3D correspondences and estimate the final rigid transformation.
blocks.zh:
拟议的GRIP的一项关键设计原则是,可靠的2D-3D通信应当通过在空间上对映和点云特征进行比对的中间代表加以完善,而不是仅仅通过直接的跨模式描述比较.
因此,GRIP由四个主要部分组成: (一)点对像素的特性渲染器通过姿势感知特征的镀镀将无序点云描述符转换成图像相通的特性图,使用初始姿势T 0\mathbf{T}_{0}. (二)像素相通的相互作用变换器精炼图像特性,并通过在共享的2D网格上的双向交叉式注意,使3D衍生特性产生. iii) 分层跨摩达尔地物传播图 精制的地物回溯到稀少的3D节点,产生更新的点云描述符,以视觉信息丰富。 (四)配对和Pose估计使用精细的描述符来回收经过改进的密集的2D-3D通信并估计最终的刚性转换.

We first compute a coarse similarity matrix between the refined point cloud nodes and image patches: 𝐒 ^ i ​ j = ⟨ v ^ i P , v ^ j I ⟩ \hat{\mathbf{S}}_{ij}=\left\langle\hat{{v}}^{\mathrm{P}}_{i},\hat{{v}}^{\mathrm{I}}_{j}\right\rangle (15) where v ^ i P \hat{{v}}^{\mathrm{P}}_{i} and v ^ j I \hat{{v}}^{\mathrm{I}}_{j} denote the refined coarse descriptors of the i i -th point cloud node and the j j -th image patch, respectively. A masked top- k k selection is then applied to 𝐒 ^ \hat{\mathbf{S}} to obtain a set of coarse patch correspondences 𝒞 ^ = ( 𝐩 ^ m , 𝐮 ^ m ) m = 1 N c \hat{\mathcal{C}}={(\hat{\mathbf{p}}_{m},\hat{\mathbf{u}}_{m})}_{m=1}^{N_{c}} .

For each selected coarse correspondence, we retrieve the associated local image pixel and point cloud, and compute dense similarities between their decoded fine-level descriptors. The dense similarity between a point descriptor v i P {v}^{\mathrm{P}}_{i} and an image descriptor v j I {v}^{\mathrm{I}}_{j} is defined as 𝐒 i ​ j = ⟨ v i P , v j I ⟩ τ \mathbf{S}_{ij}=\frac{\left\langle{v}^{\mathrm{P}}_{i},{v}^{\mathrm{I}}_{j}\right\rangle}{\tau} (16) where τ \tau is a temperature parameter. Mutual top- k k selection is then applied within each matched patch pair to recover the dense pixel-to-point correspondence set 𝒞 ∗ \mathcal{C}^{*} . Finally, the 2048 2048 highest-scoring correspondences are used for pose estimation. We evaluate two final pose estimators. The first is a score-guided PnP-RANSAC variant. Instead of sampling minimal sets uniformly [ 10 ] , each correspondence is assigned a confidence score derived from the dense similarity matrix 𝐒 \mathbf{S} . Correspondences are sorted by decreasing confidence, and minimal PnP sets are first sampled from high-confidence subsets. This prioritization enables reliable matches to be tested earlier, reducing the maximum number of RANSAC iterations to 500 500 , compared with the 50,000 50{,}000 iterations used by the methods reported in Section 4 , such as [ 19 , 14 , 41 ] . Each pose hypothesis is evaluated over all correspondences using the reprojection error with an 8 8 pixel inlier threshold. The second variant is the weighted PnP solver of [ 3 ] , which directly uses the correspondence confidence scores 𝐒 \mathbf{S} to estimate the transformation in a small number of iterations, i.e., 3 3 in our case.

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行细节

blocks.en: The method is implemented in PyTorch and trained on an NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU with 32GB of memory. For both stage 1 and 2 training, we adopt the same coarse-to-fine circle loss supervision commonly used in recent image-to-point cloud registration methods [ 19 , 41 ] . The network is trained with the Adam optimizer [ 16 ] using a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , which is decayed by a factor of 0.95 0.95 at each epoch. Stage 1 is trained for 20 20 epochs, and all its parameters are frozen during stage 2. Stage 2 is then trained for 20 20 epochs with T 0 T_{0} predicted by the pretrained Stage 1. For stage 1, the 2D backbone is implemented as a 4-stage ResNet [ 12 ] with FPN [ 21 ] , with output dimensions { 128,128,256,512 } \{128,128,256,512\} . The point cloud backbone is implemented as a 3-stage KPFCNN [ 36 ] , with dimensions { 128,256,512 } \{128,256,512\} , yielding C ^ = 512 \hat{C}=512 at the coarsest level. For stage 2, the point cloud features used for Gaussian feature splatting are projected to a 128 128 -dimensional feature space, i.e. , C G ​ s = 128 {C}_{Gs}=128 . The Pixel-Aligned Interaction Transformer module is implemented with shifted-window bidirectional cross-attention using a window size of 32 32 . The image and point cloud fusion heads ϕ I \phi_{\mathrm{I}} and ϕ P \phi_{\mathrm{P}} are implemented as separate FFNs, each composed of a normalization layer, two linear projections, and a GELU activation. The input image resolution is 480 × 640 480\times 640 , and the coarsest feature grid has resolution 34 × 45 34\times 45 .

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Validation
blocks.zh: 4 实验验证

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of GRIP , we follow state of the art image to point cloud registration methods [ 41 , 27 , 5 ] and report results on the RGB-D Scenes V2 [ 17 ] and 7-Scenes [ 11 ] datasets under the Registration Recall (RR), Inlier Ratio (IR), and Feature Matching Recall (FMR) metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了评价GRIP的性能,我们遵循最新图像来指向云登记方法[41,27,5],并报告登记召回(RR),因利尔比(IR),以及特性匹配召回(FMR)度量衡下RGB-D Scenses V2 [17]和7-Scens [11]数据集的结果.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: RGB-D Scenes V2. Introduced by Lai et al. [ 17 ] , RGB-D Scenes V2 contains 14 indoor RGB-D video sequences, covering both tabletop objects and large furniture. Following prior works [ 19 , 41 , 27 ] , we construct the 2D-3D registration benchmark by fusing one point cloud fragment from every 25 consecutive depth frames and pairing it with one RGB image sampled every 25 frames. Only pairs with an overlap ratio of at least 30 % 30\% are retained. Scenes 1-8 are used for training, scenes 9 and 10 for validation, and scenes 11-14 for testing. This split yields 1,748 training pairs, 236 validation pairs, and 497 test pairs.
blocks.zh: RGB-D场景 V2. 由Lai等人介绍 [17],RGB-D Scenes V2包含14个室内的RGB-D视频序列,既包括台顶物体,也包括大型家具. 继先前的作品[19,41,27]之后,我们构建2D-3D注册基准,方法是将每25个连续深度框架的1点云片引信,并将其与每25个框架取样的1个RGB图像配对. 仅保留重叠比例至少为30% 30 QQ的对子. 场景1-8用于训练,场景9和10用于验证,场景11-14用于测试. 这种分数产生1,748对训练对,236对验证对,497对试验对.

blocks.en: 7-Scenes. Similarly, Glocker et al. [ 11 ] introduced a challenging indoor RGB-D dataset with greater scale and viewpoint variations across scenes than RGB-D Scenes V2. The dataset consists of 46 tracked RGB-D sequences captured from 7 indoor scenes using a handheld Kinect RGB-D camera at a resolution of 640 × 480 640\times 480 . We follow the same procedure as above to process the input images and point clouds. Following [ 19 , 27 ] , we retain only image-point cloud pairs with at least 50 % 50\% overlap. Using the official sequence split yields 4048 training pairs, 1011 validation pairs, and 2304 testing pairs.
blocks.zh: 7-场景. 与此类似,Glocker等人也曾表示过这种看法。 [11] 引入了具有挑战性的室内RGB-D数据集,与RGB-D Scenses V2相比,不同场景的尺度和视角差异更大. 该数据集由从7个室内场景中利用手持Kinect RGB-D相机捕获的46个跟踪RGB-D序列组成,分辨率为640×480 640\时. 我们遵循与上述相同的程序处理输入图像和点云. [19, 27] 之后,我们只保留图像点云对,至少50%的重叠. 使用官序分数输出4048对训练对,1011对验证对,2304对试验对.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: RGB-D Scenes V2
blocks.zh: RGB-D 场景 V2

blocks.en: As reported in Table 2 , GRIP achieves the best matching performance on RGB-D Scenes V2 in terms of inlier ratio (IR). In particular, GRIP reaches an IR of 60.9%, outperforming the second-best method, R 23 Net [ 6 ] , by 17.5 percentage points. Compared with [ 19 ] , which obtains 32.4% IR, this corresponds to a relative improvement of approximately 88%, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed rendering-based refinement for producing geometrically consistent correspondences.
blocks.zh: 如表2所报告,GRIP在RGB-D Scenses V2上以更强比(IR)达到最佳匹配性能. 特别是,GRIP达到60.9%的IR,比第二最佳方法R 23 Net [6] 高出17.5个百分点。 与获得32.4%IR的[19]相比,这相当于相对改进了约88%,表明拟议的渲染改进对于产生几何一致性的函证是有效的。

blocks.en: Regarding registration, following prior work [ 19 , 41 ] , we report RR at a 10 cm threshold as the primary metric. GRIP ranks second overall on this metric, reaching 84.6% RR with EPro-PnP and 84.9% RR with score-guided RANSAC, while Diff-Reg [ 41 ] , which adopts a diffusion process, obtains 85.7%. This indicates that the substantial gains in correspondence quality translate into highly competitive registration recall. Moreover, although GRIP has a slightly higher network forward time than Diff-Reg, its total inference time is lower because the final pose estimation stage is substantially more efficient. Under identical hardware conditions, GRIP reduces total inference latency by 40.2% with EPro-PnP and by 27.8% with score-guided RANSAC compared to Diff-Reg (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 关于登记,在先前的工作[19,41]之后,我们报告RR在10厘米阈值作为主要衡量标准。 总体来说,GRIP在这一衡量标准上名列第二,EPro-PnP的RR为84.6%,RANSAC的RR为84.9%,而采用扩散程序的Diff-Reg[41]则获得85.7%。 这表明,函证质量的大幅提高转化为高度竞争性的登记召回。 此外,尽管GRIP的网络前期时间略高于Diff-Reg,但其总推论时间却较低,因为最终的姿势估计阶段要高效得多. 在相同的硬件条件下,与Diff-Reg相比,GRIP将EPro-PnP的总推论延迟率减少40.2%,将分数制导的RANSAC减少27.8%(表3)。

blocks.en: 7-Scenes.
blocks.zh: 7-场景.

blocks.en: Similarly, following previous works [ 19 , 41 ] , we evaluate the same metrics on the 7-Scenes dataset. The results reported in Table 2 show trends consistent with those observed on RGBD Scenes V2. In particular, GRIP achieves the best IR, reaching 71.9 % 71.9\% . Compared with the 2D3DMATR baseline, which achieves an IR of 50.1 % 50.1\% , this represents an absolute improvement of 21.8 21.8 percentage points and a relative improvement of approximately 43.5 % 43.5\% . The second-best method is R 23 Net, at 54.9%, which is 17.0 percentage points lower than our method. This substantial gain in IR indicates that GRIP produces significantly more geometrically consistent 2D-to-3D correspondences, as qualitatively illustrated in Fig. 3 . Although the Feature Matching Recall (FMR) of GRIP is slightly lower than the best reported value, its substantially higher IR indicates that the predicted correspondences are more geometrically consistent once a sufficient set of matches is established. This improved correspondence quality directly benefits pose estimation. GRIP achieves an RR of 84.1 % 84.1\% with EPro-PnP and 84.2 % 84.2\% with score-guided RANSAC, outperforming all compared methods. These results show that the proposed method not only increases the number of tentative matches but also improves their geometric accuracy, leading to more robust and successful registration.
blocks.zh: 同样,在以往的作品[19,41]之后,我们评价了7幕数据集的相同衡量标准。 表2中报告的结果显示的趋势与RGBD场景V2中观察到的趋势一致。 特别是,GRIP取得了最好的IR,达到71.9%的71.9%。 与2D3DMATR基线相比,该基线的IR率为50.1%,即21.821.8个百分点的绝对改善和43.5%左右的相对改善。 第二好的方法是R 23 Net,占54.9%,比我们的方法低17.0%. IR中的这一实质性收益表明,如图3所示,GRIP生产比2D到3D的通信更加几何一致。 虽然GRIP的特征匹配回调(FMR)略低于最佳报告值,但其大幅提升的IR表示,一旦建立一套充分的匹配,预测的函证更加几何一致性. 这种改善的函证质量直接带来了估计。 GRIP在EPro-PnP中实现了84.1%的RR(84.1%),在RANSAC中实现了84.2%的84.2%的RR(84.2%),比所有比较方法都好。 这些结果表明,拟议的方法不仅增加了暂定火柴的数量,而且提高了几何精确度,导致登记工作更加有力和成功。

blocks.en: In addition, we compute the RR for both datasets using thresholds ranging from 2 cm to 10 cm. As shown in Fig. 2 , GRIP achieves higher RR under stricter thresholds, demonstrating its superior registration precision. Under more relaxed thresholds, Diff-Reg gradually closes the gap with GRIP and surpasses it on RGBD Scenes V2, regardless of the pose estimator used.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们使用2厘米至10厘米的阈值计算两个数据集的RR值。 如法智所显. 2,GRIP在更严格的阈值下实现了更高的RR,显示出其较高的注册精度. 在更宽松的阈值下,迪夫-Reg逐渐缩小了与GRIP的差距,并在RGBD Scenes V2上超越它,无论使用的姿势估计器如何.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that the complete GRIP pipeline improves IR/RR from 44.2 / 78.1 44.2/78.1 with the DINOv2 based Stage 1 to 60.9 / 84.9 60.9/84.9 , corresponding to gains of + 16.7 +16.7 IR and + 6.8 +6.8 RR. The ablations indicate complementary contributions from Gaussian splatting, PAIT, and hierarchical decoding. PAIT provides the largest improvement by enabling cross modal interaction on the rendered feature grid, while the hierarchical decoder propagates the refined representation to fine matching. Replacing Gaussian splatting with hard point to pixel projection slightly decreases IR/RR to 59.3 / 82.3 59.3/82.3 , with no substantial runtime reduction ( 882 882 ms vs. 895 895 ms). Overall, these results support the contribution of each component to the complete refinement pipeline.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,完整的GRIP管道将IR/RR从44.2/78.1 44.2/78.1改进为60.9/84.9,即+16.7+16.7IR和+6.8+6.8RR。 浮标表明高斯浮标、PAIT和等级解码的辅助贡献。 PAIT提供了最大的改进,在制成的特征网格上实现了跨模式的相互作用,而等级解码器则将精细的表示传播给精细的匹配. 用硬点来取代高斯电镀以像素投影,将IR/RR略减为59.3/82.3 59.3/82.3,没有大幅缩短运行时间(882 882 ms对895 895 ms). 总体而言,这些成果支持了每个构成部分对全面改进管道的贡献。

blocks.en: 4.4 Discussion and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 4.4 讨论和未来方向

blocks.en: Experiments on RGB-D Scenes V2 and 7-Scenes demonstrate the effectiveness of GRIP for cross-modal image-to-point cloud matching, with particularly strong performance under stricter registration thresholds. For a fair comparison, the results of 2D3D-MATR and Diff-Reg were reproduced using their official implementations in the same experimental environment as GRIP . Overall, the results confirm that the proposed rendering-based refinement improves the geometric consistency of the predicted correspondences.
blocks.zh: RGB-D Scenes V2和7-Scenes的实验证明了GRIP对跨模式图像对点云匹配的有效性,在更严格的注册门槛下表现特别强. 为了进行公平的比较,2D3D-MATR和Diff-Reg的结果是在与GRIP相同的实验环境中使用它们的官方执行来复制的. 总的来说,这些结果证实,拟议的以渲染为基础的改进可以提高预测函证的几何一致性。

blocks.en: The main limitation of GRIP is its dependence on the initial pose. Since feature splatting uses 𝐓 0 \mathbf{T}_{0} to project 3D features into the image plane, this initialization must be sufficiently accurate to produce meaningful rendered features. When the initial pose is degenerate or highly inaccurate, the rendered representation becomes poorly aligned with the image observations. As a result, the pixel-aligned transformer may receive uninformative or misleading evidence, which can lead to incorrect correspondences and degrade the final pose. This behavior is particularly evident on the Stairs scene of the 7-Scenes dataset, where the weak baseline initialization performance, i.e., a RR of 28.4% and an IR of 18.1%, also limits the improvement achieved by GRIP , which reaches a RR of 31.1% and an IR of 28.6%. These results suggest that the proposed method should be viewed as a pose-conditioned rendering-based refinement framework whose performance depends on the quality of the initial pose, rather than as a solution to arbitrary initialization.
blocks.zh: GRIP的主要局限在于其对初始姿势的依赖. 由于特性电镀使用T 0\ mathbf{T}_{0}将3D特性投射到图像平面中,这种初始化必须足够准确,以产生有意义的渲染特性. 当最初的姿势变质或高度不准确时,所提供的代表就变得与图像观测差。 因此,像素对齐的变压器可能会收到非成像性或误导性的证据,这可能导致不正确的函式,并降低最终的姿势. 这种行为在7-Scases数据集的楼梯场景中特别明显,其中基线初始化性能薄弱,即RR为28.4%,IR为18.1%,这也限制了GRIP实现的改进,RR为31.1%,IR为28.6%. 这些结果表明,应把拟议方法视为一个有条件的渲染改进框架,其业绩取决于初始姿势的质量,而不是任意初始化的解决办法。

blocks.en: A promising direction for future work is therefore to reduce the dependence on a single initial transformation. One possibility is to integrate GRIP into a generative or diffusion-based registration framework [ 13 , 41 , 27 ] , where the pose is progressively refined from a noisy transformation on the SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE(3)} manifold. Another direction is to sample multiple pose candidates around the initial transformation. Each candidate can produce its own feature-splatting representation, enabling the model to assess multiple alignment hypotheses simultaneously. This raises the likelihood of obtaining at least one informative rendering, effectively broadening the convergence basin and mitigating the impact of poor initializations.
blocks.zh: 因此,未来工作的一个有希望的方向是减少对单一初步转变的依赖。 一种可能性是将GRIP纳入基于基因或扩散的登记框架[13、41、27],从SE QQ(3)\mathrm{SE(3)}多维的噪音转换中逐步改进姿势。 另一个方向是围绕初始转型对多个姿势候选人进行抽样. 每个候选者可以产生自己的特征浮雕代表,使模型能够同时评估多个对齐假说. 这增加了至少获得一次信息传播的可能性,有效地扩大了汇合盆地,并减轻了初始化不良的影响。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced GRIP , a pose-conditioned rendering-based refinement framework for 2D-3D feature matching and registration. The main objective of our approach is to reduce the structural gap between grid-based image descriptors and unordered point cloud descriptors. To this end, we proposed a feature-splatting module that renders learned 3D point features into the image plane, producing an image-aligned point-derived feature map. A pixel-aligned interaction transformer then jointly refines image features and 3D-derived rendered features via bidirectional cross-modal attention on a shared 2D grid. The refined rendered features are finally sampled back to the 3D nodes, enabling improved dense 2D-3D correspondence estimation and final pose refinement. The refined representation improves dense correspondence quality, achieving the highest IR on both evaluated benchmarks and competitive RR, particularly under stricter thresholds. Future work will focus on reducing the dependence on the initial pose through multi-hypothesis or generative refinement.
